design_disclosure: Model, matched null, cases, scores and thresholds specified analytically before numerical production.
histories: All four equal-weight initial (h,G) in {0,1}^2 and both fair coin values. No postselection.

internal_trials.intact: At every size and history test F=0,1,2,3 with intact K. Fault scores include the flipped archived color.
internal_trials.controls: F=2, all seven K values, every history and size. Scrambled arms score both coin values.
internal_trials.snapshots: Check number of filled cells at first and second diagnostic edges, first full write and end. Before last rebuild write a blank still exists on the ordered path.
internal_trials.record: Check initial M=e and M=h at the first two fault edges before K acts.

external_trials.scope: One unflagged laboratory flip per trial, without a clock measurement. Include both early construction and postcompletion.
external_trials.endpoint_solver: Group exact endpoint amplitudes by complete final basis state with binomial weights. Include correct archive and head L in unconditional success.

null: Same preparations, assay, route, clock and perturbations. Deposits read h instead of M. Check intact observational identity and invariance of target under M interventions.
verification: Exact path and finite clock bounds. Separate small reachable physical Hamiltonian construction and propagation with a lab pulse, including clock tails. Verify acquisition, resource ledger and exact energy law.
scope: Supplied bounded local reversible program with a finite internal route. Externally timed pulses are tests. Distinguish generated structure, acquired causal memory, target programming, collective emergence and physical novelty.
